sans.purpose: All UI text. Native integration with browser chrome.

display.purpose: Popup title only. Confident, present, not loud.

label.purpose: Field labels, metadata. Small, scannable, uppercase.

shadows.name: small
shadows.purpose: Subtle lift for buttons and small elements.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action button. Cyan background, dark text. Appears only for the primary action.
components.css: .tz-btn-primary { color: #0f0f17; background-color: #00d4ff; border-color: #00d4ff; border-radius: 10px; height: 34px; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid transparent; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .tz-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #33dfff; border-color: #33dfff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(0,212,255,0.15), 0 0 20px rgba(0,212,255,0.25); } .tz-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .tz-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.35; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary actions. Glass surface with subtle border.
components.css: .tz-btn-secondary { color: #e8e8f0; background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 10px; height: 34px; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid transparent; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .tz-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.07); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); } .tz-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.35; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .tz-btn-ghost { color: #9898a8; background: transparent; border-color: transparent; border-radius: 10px; height: 34px; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid transparent; transition: color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .tz-btn-ghost:hover { color: #e8e8f0; background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); } .tz-btn-ghost:disabled { opacity: 0.35; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Toggle Select
components.description: Connected button group for format selection. Active option uses focus cyan.
components.css: .tz-select { display: inline-flex; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 10px; background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); } .tz-select-option { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 34px; padding: 0 12px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: #9898a8; cursor: pointer; background: transparent; border: none; transition: background-color 120ms, color 120ms; } .tz-select-option--active { color: #0f0f17; background-color: #00d4ff; } .tz-select-option:hover:not(.tz-select-option--active) { color: #e8e8f0; background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.07); }

components.name: Toast
components.description: Ephemeral notification. Pill-shaped, glass surface, centered at bottom.
components.css: .tz-toast { min-width: 180px; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: #e8e8f0; text-align: center; background-color: #1c1c28; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); }

narrative.overview: Tamiz is a precision instrument for extracting signal from noise. The visual system draws from microscope and telescope aesthetics — concentric focus rings, layered depth, and the moment when blur resolves into clarity. Every surface exists to bring exactly the content you need into focus, then recede.
keyCharacteristics: Dark ground with glass-layer depth (backdrop-filter blur)
Single cyan focus accent — appears only during active selection
Concentric focus rings as the visual signature

rules.name: The Focus Rarity Rule
rules.body: The cyan accent appears on ≤15% of any given surface. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Ground Purity Rule
rules.body: Never use colored overlays or tinted backgrounds on the ground surfaces.

rules.name: The System Stack Rule
rules.body: Never import custom fonts. The system stack is the point.

rules.name: The Glass Layer Rule
rules.body: Surfaces that float above the page use backdrop-filter blur with semi-transparent backgrounds.

dos: Do use the cyan accent only for active focus states
Do use backdrop-filter blur on floating surfaces
Do keep typography at system defaults
Do use glass surfaces (4-10% white) for secondary elements
Do animate entrance with scale + fade
donts: Don't use cyan as a general accent
Don't add borders heavier than 1px at 8% opacity
Don't use gradient backgrounds or decorative overlays
Don't stack cards or nest panels
